note: 50 search-then-invoke turns over a reconstruction of the catalog from the 2026-08-11 misranking investigation, for the intent-graph measurement harness. The first 12 are the incident queries verbatim; the rest add the report's 'searched, found nothing, created' trajectory (a read-phrased query whose turn ends in create_task, which is why the write op dominated every cluster), deliberate near-repeats that MUST stay merged as the over-split guard, and further domains taken from the production disagreement cards: documents, counting-vs-retrieval, comments, task relationships, projects and review. `intent` labels what the QUERY wanted, not what was invoked -- they are a judgement call, find/exists especially, and any purity metric scored against them inherits that opinion. Regenerate vectors with: cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib regenerate_harness_fixtures -- --ignored
